With `mode="range"`, after the first click hovering or focusing a day previews the range the next click will select. `numberOfMonths` shows months side by side, stacked on narrow screens.
With reduced motion, month changes fade and the height change is instant.
Without a mode, days are not selectable.
`captionLayout="dropdown"` replaces the caption with native selects, so phones get their own picker. Set `startMonth` and `endMonth` to bound the years.
`min` and `max` limit the range length in days. With `excludeDisabled`, a range that would include a disabled day starts over instead.
`mode="multiple"` toggles individual days. `max` caps how many can be selected.
`showWeekNumber` adds a week column. `ISOWeek` uses ISO numbering, starting on Monday. `showOutsideDays={false}` hides days of other months.
